description: Read actual Orpinn data and images; preview catalog, shared prices, paper-menu imports, menu content and hours with independent browser approval and undo.

interface.longDescription: Connect your Orpinn account and explicitly select branches and permissions. Read actual sales, products, categories, electronic-menu item overrides, assigned images and hours. Missing data or image access is reported explicitly without substitutes. When separately enabled, preview catalog creation, updates and recoverable archive, shared organization prices, chosen product images, paper-menu comparisons and imports, and menu design, SEO, contact, hours or ordering settings. Host-generated images can be supplied only through a real file handoff; Orpinn does not provide an image-generation engine. Review every target and affected branch in the authenticated Orpinn card before each change or separate undo. Source-image verification does not certify OCR; choose add/update/skip for every transcribed row. Queued work remains pending until completed; server acceptance does not prove POS synchronization. New tools require deployed backend support and fresh explicit grants. Security/permission administration, licensing, hard deletion, stock movements, payments, order creation and device administration remain unavailable.
